title: The Journey: Big Ten Basketball
description:
Purdue
Through challenges, signature wins and an epic Big Ten Tournament run, take a look back at Purdue's memorable season. Hear from Braden Smith, Trey Kaufman-Renn and Fletcher Loyer as they become the winningest trio in school history.

title: College Basketball
description:
Valparaiso at Purdue
The Purdue Boilermakers clash with the Valparaiso Beacons in regular NCAA play. Purdue relies on junior Daniel Jacobsen following his strong frontcourt debut against Gonzaga, while Valparaiso counts on quick transition scoring and 11 team assists.

title: College Basketball
description:
Eastern Illinois at Iowa
The Eastern Illinois Panthers and the Iowa Hawkeyes meet at Carver-Hawkeye Arena for an NCAA regular-season game. Eastern Illinois enters after a 91-57 loss against Indiana where Demar Burton scored 10 points, while Iowa relies on Ty'Reek Coleman.

title: College Basketball
description:
North Florida at UCLA
The UCLA Bruins clash with the North Florida Ospreys in a regular-season NCAA basketball game. UCLA looks to build on scoring form following an 84-75 opening win over Arizona, while North Florida leans on perimeter execution behind guard JR Bartelus.

The Badgers (5-3, 3-2 Big Ten) try to continue their mastery of the Scarlet Knights (2-6, 1-4). The Badgers have won all six get-togethers, by an average of 30 points. Wisconsin tries to get its offense back in gear following a 30-0 loss to Iowa.
